beginner.label: Beginner
beginner.description: Never touched a terminal? Start here. Explanations after every step, gentle nudges, up to 3 hints and a solution when you're stuck.

normal.label: Normal
normal.description: You know what a terminal is. Objectives and realistic machines, fewer nudges. Hints and solutions stay available. You may :skip.

expert.label: Expert
expert.description: Tickets, not tutorials. Vague objectives, one hint, no solutions, bonus XP for solving fast. Skip whatever you already know.
